_comment: Ground truth for `ci-ledger precision`. Identities are the suite (JUnit classname) and name emitted by test/flake-canary.test.ts, which is deliberately non-deterministic and ships a stable control beside it. Every other test in this repository is left unlabelled on purpose: an unlabelled finding is reported but never scored, so the number stays honest.

flaky.name: flake canary > fails about half the time on purpose

stable.name: flake canary > is stable, as a control
